name: Kaizuka Fumiko
source:
Fumiko is the wife of [url=https://vndb.org/c57230]Hidetaka[/url].

After the fire that burns down the Odaka couple's appartment, they decided to take them under their roof. She loves her husband deeply and will do almost anything for him.
